properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 13 at 5:36AM EDT until October 15 at 11:51AM EDT by NWS Columbia SC
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in South
Carolina...

Congaree River At Congaree River at Congaree NP Near Gadsden
affecting Calhoun and Richland Counties.

Congaree River At Carolina Eastman affecting Calhoun, Lexington and
Richland Counties.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...Congaree River at Carolina Eastman.

* WHEN...Until Thursday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 115.0 feet, Flooding occurs in low lying areas of the
Carolina Eastman Facility and at the Congaree National Park. At
119.0 feet, Extensive flooding occurs in the Congaree National
Park. Some area farmland is flooded. Minor flooding occurs at the
Carolina Eastman Facility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 5:04 AM EDT Tuesday the stage was 117.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 114.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 5:04 AM EDT Tuesday was 117.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 119.0 feet
this morning. It will then fall below flood stage late tomorrow
morning.
- Flood stage is 115.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Most flooding deaths occur in vehicles. Never drive through a flooded
roadway or around barricades. Turn around, don't drown.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 700 PM EDT.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 13 at 1:31AM MST until October 13 at 8:00AM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Gila County in east central Arizona...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 800 AM MST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, and normally dry washes is
imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 125 AM MST, river gauges on West Clear Creek running into
Verde Lakes and Camp Verde, Fossil Creek, East Verde River, and
the Verde River south of Camp Verde are reporting high flows
which will cause flooding of low water crossings
- This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Houston Creek, Gap Creek, Bull Run Creek, Pigeon Creek, West
Clear Creek, Cold Water Creek, Chasm Creek, Hardscrabble Creek,
Long Canyon, Fossil Creek, East Verde River, and Verde River.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Camp Verde along West Clear Creek, Verde Lakes, Childs Power
Plant, Rockin' River Ranch State Park, Cedar Bench Wilderness,
The Toilet Bowl, Fossil Springs Wilderness, Indian Maiden Falls
and West Clear Creek Wilderness.
- This includes the following recreation areas andcampgrounds...
Clear Creek Group Campgrounds.

This includes the following swimming holes...
All swimming holes and waterfalls on Fossil Creek, Bull Pen Day
Use Area, West Clear Creek near the campground, Fossil Creek Dam
"The Toilet Bowl" and Indian Maiden Falls.
- Additional information is available at weather.gov/flagstaff.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued October 12 at 9:06PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.

.The St Johns River at Astor remains in Moderate Flood Stage due to
north winds and upstream heavy rainfall draining through the basin.
River levels are forecast to remain near the Moderate Flood Stage
level of 3.0 feet through this week.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 2.8 feet, Docks and boat ramps covered at South Moon
Fish Camp and approaching sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den. Water
approaching sites closest to the river at Fish Tales RV Resort and
Astor Landing Campground. Portion of Clair Street covered by river
water south of the Butler Boat Ramp. Docks underwater at the Astor
Bridge Marina and along Riveredge Drive. Portions of Fox Road are
covered with water nearest to the river. Acorn, Hazelnut and Redbud
roads are underwater with yards inundated. At 3.0 feet, Water
approaches or may enter lowest homes on or near Wildhog Road and
nearby canals. Flooding reaches the parking lot of the Juno Trail
Apartments. Flooding on portions of Alligator Road and Holiday
Road. Lowest lying yards along Blue Creek are flooded. Roads at
Astor Landing Campground and Lake Dexter Boat Ramp begin to flood.
Water enters lower homes closest to the river on McPherson Lane.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Monday the stage was 3.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 PM EDT Monday was 3.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain steady at around 3.0
feet through this week.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
